type IsStr<T> = { v: T } extends { v: string } ? "str" : "other";
function f<T>(x: T): IsStr<T> {
  return (typeof x === "string" ? "str" : "other") as IsStr<T>;
}
const a: "str" = f("x");
const b: "other" = f(1);
type RetStr<T> = (() => T) extends () => string ? "yes" : "no";
function k<T>(x: T): RetStr<T> {
  return (typeof x === "string" ? "yes" : "no") as RetStr<T>;
}
const c: "yes" = k("s");
const d: "no" = k(true);
console.log(a, b, c, d);
